paper_title: Constraints on axion-like dark matter from a SERF comagnetometer
notes: NASDUCK-SERF SERF comagnetometer using 3He and 39K. Constrains both ALP-neutron (gaNN) and ALP-proton (gaPP) couplings; the paper's novel highlight is the first reliable terrestrial ALP-proton bound, so coupling_type set to AxionProton. Mass range 1.4 peV to 200 peV. Precise bounds tabulated in external GitHub repo [57]; data_points here are approximate reads from Fig.2 (right panel, mean exclusion) and partially closes regions 5e-6 to 2e-5 GeV^-1 and (1-9)e-3 GeV^-1. A separate AxionNeutron limit (gaNN, ~1e-7 to 1e-3 GeV^-1) is also reported. Standard local DM density assumed but specific value not stated in text.
